create_omnigen_pipeline: create an OmniGenPipeline instance for multimodal-to-image generation with a transformer, scheduler, VAE, and tokenizer
run_omnigen_generate: run the OmniGenPipeline __call__ method to generate images from text prompts with optional input images
encode_input_images: encode input images into latent representations using the VAE encoder for multimodal processing
prepare_latents: prepare random Gaussian latents with the correct batch size, channels, height, and width for diffusion
retrieve_timesteps: retrieve scheduler timesteps from a diffusion scheduler using num_inference_steps, custom timesteps, or sigmas
